name: Australian National University
summary: Canberra campus with 19 residences and an accommodation offer guaranteed to international first-years starting in Semester 1; six academic colleges.

ib.text: ANU converts your IB total to an entrance rank: 31 points is rank 80, 33 is 85, 35 is 90, 38 is 94, 41 is 97. Each program sets its rank and some add prerequisites. Results go to ANU through the IB.

apply.via: ANU portal or UAC (UAC encouraged for IB)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Politics, Philosophy and Economics
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Politics, Philosophy and Economics
programmes.about: A three-year degree combining political analysis, philosophical theory and economics, with a capstone course; run by the ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences.
programmes.ib: Rank 94 guarantees entry, which is 38 IB points on ANU's table; rank 79 is the minimum that is considered.
programmes.selectionNote: Guaranteed at rank 94 (38 IB points); below that, ranked against other applicants down to rank 79. 2027 program page.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Politics, Philosophy and Economics: ANU presents itself as a leader in philosophy, politics and economics

faculties.name: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Bachelor of Arts: guaranteed at rank 80 (31 IB points). Politics, Philosophy and Economics asks rank 94 (38 points).

faculties.name: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
faculties.line: Bachelor of Asian Studies: guaranteed at rank 80 (31 IB points).

faculties.name: ANU College of Business and Economics
faculties.line: Commerce, Economics and Business Administration: guaranteed at rank 80 (31 IB points).

faculties.name: ANU College of Law, Governance and Policy
faculties.line: Bachelor of Laws (Honours): guaranteed at rank 97, which is 41 IB points on ANU's table.

faculties.name: ANU College of Science and Medicine
faculties.line: Bachelor of Science: guaranteed at rank 80 (31 IB points); no formal program prerequisites.

faculties.name: ANU College of Systems and Society
faculties.line: Computing at rank 80 (31 IB points), Engineering (Honours) at rank 85 (33); both list a Mathematics Advanced prerequisite.

notes: IB students are encouraged to apply through UAC, where they may receive subject adjustment factors; applying direct to ANU gets none.
Program prerequisites are written in NSW and ACT terms (for example HSC Mathematics Advanced 'or equivalent'); ask ANU what IB course counts.
International students starting in Semester 1 are guaranteed an offer of on-campus accommodation.
